zh-CN.dailyProfitHint: 使用地标财务账本显示今日和昨日净额（§）。构建时补齐原生账本依赖。
zh-CN.profitIndexHint: 商业或工业经营指标。显示当前值和上次采样，无货币单位。
zh-CN.tourismProfitHint: 观光地标账本的今日和昨日净额（§），已扣除账本记入的支出。
zh-CN.tourismRevenueHint: 各收入档的当前游客数乘以对应费率（§/小时）。
zh-CN.sharedBusinessProfitHint: 全楼共用账本的今日和昨日净额（§），合计办公和零售收入并扣除已记账支出。
zh-CN.buildingWorkersHint: 按收入档显示整栋建筑的在岗劳工与岗位数。每档人数含基础劳工和额外在岗劳工。

en-US.dailyProfitHint: Shows today's and yesterday's net totals (§) from the landmark ledger. Builds include the native ledger dependency.
en-US.profitIndexHint: Shows the current and previous commercial or industrial performance index, without currency units.
en-US.tourismProfitHint: Shows today's and yesterday's net totals (§) from the tourism landmark ledger after recorded expenses.
en-US.tourismRevenueHint: Multiplies the current tourist count in each wealth tier by its rate (§/hour).
en-US.sharedBusinessProfitHint: Shows today's and yesterday's building-wide net totals (§), combining office and retail income and deducting recorded expenses.
en-US.buildingWorkersHint: Shows workers on duty and jobs across the building by wealth tier, including both base and additional workers on duty.
